reuse.why: Extends the two existing holiday mechanisms (getDateWithSkippedWeekend for moves, recurConfigToExcludedRules for daily skips) and expresses yearly holidays as an RSchedule YEARLY rule instead of new date arithmetic.

duplication.why: Holiday matching for moves is pulled into one isHoliday helper used by both branches of getDateWithSkippedWeekend; the MM-DD notion is still encoded twice (slice(5) lookup and the isYearlyHoliday regex) because the two mechanisms differ.

placement.why: All changes sit in shared/schedules.ts where the holiday and exclusion-rule logic already lives.

scope.why: Focused on MM-DD holidays, with a small incidental widening of the ScheduleRuleOptions type for byDayOfWeek.

maintainability.why: Small, readable change with named helpers and a comment on the leap-year start; two parallel holiday interpretations remain to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing holiday paths and RSchedule rules; no caller bypasses them.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated block is reshaped; the old inline holiday checks are replaced by isHoliday.
